# NPM Improved v1.7.8

Stable maintenance release.

## Fixes

- Corrected release-channel selection so the update page requests the chosen channel instead of displaying the Stable result for every selection.
- Fixed independent release-cache handling and version comparisons.
- Corrected update-availability reporting when a channel has no published release or GitHub cannot be reached.
- Added architecture-aware release validation so unsupported image packages cannot be installed.
- Improved the existing native updater's automatic maintenance and compatibility across updater protocol versions.
- Preserved authenticated, checksum-verified updates and rollback protections.
- Reduced unnecessary updater maintenance warnings and improved progress reporting.

## Updating

Open **Settings → Update**, select **Stable**, and install **v1.7.8**. Existing native updater installations are upgraded through the normal in-app process, without a separate installer.

Existing ports, persistent application data, and deployment configuration are preserved by the normal updater workflow. Shared-database installations remain subject to their existing coordinated-update safeguards.
